getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.text:
O le lipotiina o taimi faʻatali ma faʻafitauli e mafai na o le app feaveaʻi a PickupRadar.

O le vaʻaiga i lenei upega tafaʻilagi mo le matamata na o ia.

getApp.cityAlert.en:

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.text:
Talosaga mo PickupRadar i lou aai.

O talosaga mo aai e lafo mai le app feaveaʻi.
